item.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story database
summary:      Declare the rates schema and repository operations.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
covers:       Feature
stack:        persistence.md, sqlite.md
provides:     rates.get, rates.list, rates.upsert, rates.delete
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Declare the rates table and its repository operations for publication-date queries, currency queries, upserts, and deletion. Keep stored rates as text and use the generated persistence package for all database access.

## story architecture
summary:      Define application module boundaries and runtime wiring.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
covers:       Screen
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Establish the application structure, configuration resolution, FastAPI application factory, CLI entry point, and module boundaries. Route all database access through the shipped persistence library and keep fetch testable without network access.

## story cli_init
summary:      Initialize an empty rates database.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-INIT.md
covers:       CLI-001
accepts:      st-003
stack:        python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database, architecture
provides:     fxrates init
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement init so it drops and recreates the rates table, succeeds silently, and leaves an empty store.

## story cli_load
summary:      Validate and load ECB history files atomically and idempotently.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-LOAD.md
covers:       CLI-002, CLI-004
accepts:      st-003
stack:        python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database, architecture
provides:     fxrates load
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement complete-file validation before writes, preserve published rate text, omit N/A entries, replace existing date/currency rates, and report counts for dates with rates and stored rates.

## story cli_fetch
summary:      Fetch and load the ECB history archive.
type:         service
kind:         integration
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-FETCH.md
covers:       CLI-003
accepts:      st-009
stack:        python.md, cli.md
depends:      cli_load, architecture
provides:     fxrates fetch
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Download and extract the ECB archive and load its CSV through the same validation and persistence path as load. Keep automated tests fully stubbed from network access.

## story api_health_stats
summary:      Serve health and database statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-HEALTH-STATS.md
covers:       API-001
accepts:      st-004
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database, architecture
provides:     GET /health, GET /stats
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement JSON health and statistics endpoints, including empty-store behavior and date bounds.

## story api_currencies
summary:      List the base currency and currencies with stored rates.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-CURRENCIES.md
covers:       API-002
accepts:      st-008
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database, architecture
provides:     GET /currencies
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Return EUR as base and stored currencies in ascending order.

## story api_rates
summary:      Resolve date-specific and latest effective rates.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-RATES.md
covers:       API-003
accepts:      st-005
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database, architecture
provides:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /rates/latest
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Resolve the latest publication on or before a requested date, return exact stored rate text, validate dates, and return 404 when no effective publication exists.

## story api_convert
summary:      Convert amounts between currencies with exact decimal arithmetic.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-CONVERT.md
covers:       API-004
accepts:      st-006, st-007
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database, architecture
provides:     GET /convert
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Validate required parameters and amounts, resolve the effective date, validate currency availability, and calculate rate and result using Decimal with half-even rounding.

## story api_history
summary:      Retrieve bounded currency history and exact statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-HISTORY.md
covers:       API-005
accepts:      st-005, st-006, st-007
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
depends:      database, architecture
provides:     GET /history/{code}
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Return ascending bounded publication points with stored text and exact min, max, and mean values; distinguish an empty bounded result from a currency with no stored rates.

## story api_reference
summary:      Expose API discovery documentation.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-REFERENCE.md
acceptance:   yes
depends:      architecture
covers:       API-003
stack:        python.md, fastapi.md
provides:     GET /openapi.json
instructions: |
  Expose the FastAPI OpenAPI document as the programmatic API discovery entry point.

## story test_suite
summary:      Provide the automated pytest suite and POSIX runner.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-TEST-SUITE.md
covers:       TEST-001
accepts:      st-002, st-009
stack:        common.md, python.md
depends:      cli_init, cli_load, cli_fetch, api_health_stats, api_currencies, api_rates, api_convert, api_history, api_reference
context:      sources/run.sh, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
context_roles: |
  sources/run.sh: context
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv: asset
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Provide bin/test.sh and a pytest suite covering the command workflows, loading rules, API routes, effective-date resolution, rounding, and error statuses. Stub fetch downloads and ensure tests do not open network connections.

## story verify_release
summary:      Run the supplied grader as the terminal release verification.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   VERIFICATION.md
accepts:      st-001
stack:        common.md, python.md
depends:      database, architecture, cli_init, cli_load, cli_fetch, api_health_stats, api_currencies, api_rates, api_convert, api_history, api_reference, test_suite
context:      sources/run.sh
context_roles: |
  sources/run.sh: context
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Bind terminal acceptance to the supplied conformance grader over the complete application. Do not reproduce its known answers in hand-authored assertions.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
